what: a wyvern: the two-legged dragon of heraldry, a real flying reptile seen from the side, lean, light and quick, shaped like a pterodactyl with a dragon's head. Its wings are its arms, like a bat's: two broad leathery wings stretched on long finger bones, and it has no other front limbs; its chest is a smooth scaled keel. It has exactly two legs, strong scaly hind legs with hooked black talons, set far back under its hips. It has a slim neck and a narrow wedge-shaped dragon's head with a smooth bare skull and a jaw of small sharp teeth. Its long thick scaly tail swings down and forward beneath its body in a hook. The last part of the tail is its sting: there the tail swells into one fat glossy jet-black club, twice as thick as the tail itself and as long as the wyvern's head, which ends in one curved black spike. The black sting is part of the tail and is the darkest thing in the picture.
colours: dull grey-brown scales the colour of dry mud on the head, neck, body, legs and tail, with no orange and no peach, a pale bone-grey belly, dark umber-brown wing membranes, a glossy black sting, black talons, yellow eyes.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal and holds nothing; both taloned feet are empty and open.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left, it flies down to the left through empty air with nothing beneath it, small in the middle of the picture with wide empty backdrop all round, both wings raised above its back and well inside the picture, its two hind legs hanging beneath its hips with the talons hooked, neck stretched out with the jaws open screeching and nothing in its mouth, and its tail hooked down and forward under its legs with the fat black sting at its tip thrust forward to stab.
must_show: a dragon-like reptile with exactly two legs and two wings, seen from the side
flying, wings raised, jaws open
a tail hooked forward ending in one fat black sting, readable in the small sprite
dull grey-brown scales, lean and plain: the lesser wyvern
must_not_show: wing cut off by the edge of the picture

what: a yellow musk creeper: a living climbing plant that hunts, one dense tangle of thick twisting dark green creeper stems rearing up like a nest of snakes, each stem as thick as a man's wrist and studded with big hooked brown thorns, with a few broad dark green heart-shaped leaves. Out of the top of the tangle open four big trumpet-shaped flowers of deep golden yellow, each flower a quarter of the whole plant wide, with a dark orange throat, all gaping to the left like open mouths. Out of the mouth of each flower bursts one thick round puff of dull yellow pollen dust, like a puff of smoke, as big as the flower and still touching it. A short tuft of pale roots hangs at the bottom of the tangle. It is only a plant.
colours: dark green thorny stems, darker green leaves, brown thorns, deep golden-yellow flowers with dark orange throats, thick puffs of dull mustard-yellow pollen at the flower mouths, pale tan roots.
wears: It is a plant and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing. Two long thick thorny green tendrils, each as thick as a man's wrist, whip out from the tangle, their tips curled like hooks.
pose: The tangle of stems rears up and lunges to the left, its yellow flowers thrust forward puffing out pollen, one thick thorny tendril lashing out to the left like a whip and another raised high and curling over to strike; neither tendril reaches the edge of the picture.
must_show: a tangle of thick green thorny creeper stems
several big yellow trumpet flowers, readable in the small sprite
puffs of yellow pollen at the flower mouths, joined to them
two thick lashing tendrils
a hunting plant with no face, not a garden bouquet
must_not_show: big cloud of pollen hiding the plant

what: a rotting zombie: a walking human corpse of ordinary build that is falling apart, a dead man long in the ground. Every part of it is dead flesh, dark mouldering grey-green, the head, chest, arms and legs alike. The flesh of its chest has rotted away: its whole chest is an open cage of big bare grey-brown ribs with black gaps between them, plain to see. Both its arms are bare bone from the elbow down: two thin grey-brown forearm bones and a bony skeleton hand on each. Its head is a rotten grey-green face with a sunken hole for a nose, two blank dead white eyes, a few strands of lank hair and a lower jaw hanging open with long teeth; the inside of the mouth is black. It has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long thin limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: dark mouldering grey-green dead flesh on every part, darker than a plain zombie, dull grey-brown bone showing in the holes, blank white eyes, tattered dark earth-brown rags.
wears: It wears only a few tattered dark brown rags of trousers hanging from its hips. It has no shroud and no shirt.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing; both bony hands are open with the fingers hooked.
pose: Seen from the side, it lurches to the left on two legs, body pitched forward, one foot dragging behind, both arms stretched straight out horizontally in front of it to the left, one a little higher than the other, the bony hands clawing, head lolling, jaw hanging open.
must_show: a human corpse of ordinary size, dark grey-green dead flesh
an open cage of bare ribs for a chest, readable in the small sprite
bare bone forearms and hands
both arms stretched out ahead, empty hands
dark brown rags, no shroud
must_not_show: arms spread wide to the sides

what: a zombie legion: a whole graveyard of the dead raised at once and driven by one command, drawn as one tight wedge of walking corpses packed shoulder to shoulder, all touching, one solid mass, painted seriously. In the front are three large zombies side by side, seen from the front and a little from the left: dead men with dark grey-green rotting flesh, blank white eyes and hanging jaws, in torn dirty off-white burial shrouds and dark brown rags, each with both arms stretched out ahead and the hands clawing. Close behind them, pressed against their backs, rises a second rank: four more grey-green dead heads looking over their shoulders, and above those a thicket of a dozen grey-green arms reaching up and forward with spread fingers. Dead grey-green legs and bare feet show below the shrouds.
colours: dark grey-green rotting flesh on every head, arm and leg, blank white eyes, dirty off-white burial shrouds, dark earth-brown rags, dark gaps between the bodies.
wears: Every zombie wears a torn dirty off-white burial shroud or dark brown grave rags.
holds: They hold nothing; every hand is empty, open and clawing.
pose: The whole wedge presses to the left as one, every body leaning forward, the three front zombies reaching out to the left with both arms, the heads of the second rank crowding over their shoulders, the thicket of raised arms above them all slanting forward to the upper left.
must_show: many zombies packed into one tight mass, not one figure
three large zombies across the front with arms stretched out
more dead heads behind and a thicket of reaching arms above
grey-green dead flesh, pale shrouds and brown rags
all touching, one mass

what: a giant cave bat: a real bat, an animal, drawn large, a fierce hunting bat of the deep caves. It has a small furry body, a short snub muzzle with a wrinkled leaf-shaped nose, two very tall pointed ears as long as its head, small black eyes, a wide open mouth with four long white needle fangs, and two broad leathery wings stretched on long thin finger bones, each wing with a small hooked thumb claw at its top. Two small clawed feet hang beneath it.
colours: dark chocolate-brown fur on the body and head, a paler grey-brown chest, black-brown leathery wings with dark red-brown skin between the finger bones, a dark red mouth, white fangs.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front, it flies straight at the viewer through empty air with nothing beneath it, both wings spread wide to the left and right, the wing tips curving down, head thrust forward with the mouth wide open shrieking and the fangs bared, ears pricked, small feet tucked under it.
must_show: a real bat with two broad leathery wings spread wide
tall pointed ears and a furry brown body
open mouth with white fangs
flying, nothing under it

what: a raven of Odin's lineage: a real raven, a bird, drawn large, heavy and grim, with a thick strong black beak, shaggy throat feathers, a flat head, broad wings with long finger-like flight feathers, a wedge tail and black scaly feet with hooked talons. Its eye is one small bright point of pale gold. Round its neck it wears one thick twisted ring of bright silver, a Viking neck ring, plain to see against the black feathers.
colours: glossy coal-black feathers all over with cold steel-grey highlights, a black beak and black feet, one small pale gold eye, one thick bright silver neck ring.
wears: It wears only one thick twisted bright silver ring round its neck.
holds: It is a bird and holds nothing; both taloned feet are empty and open.
pose: Seen from the side, it swoops down to the left through empty air with nothing beneath it, both wings raised high above its back with the flight feathers spread, its two black feet thrust forward with the talons open to rake, head stretched out and the heavy beak wide open croaking, tail fanned.
must_show: a real raven: heavy black beak, all-black feathers
wings raised, talons thrust forward, beak open
one bright silver ring round the neck, visible in the small sprite
grim and fierce, not a songbird

what: a cockatrice of the medieval bestiaries: a monster with the front of a fighting cock and the back of a serpent. Its head is a real rooster's head, fierce and lean: a sharp yellow beak, a tall jagged red comb on top, two red wattles hanging under the beak and a hard round orange eye. Its neck and breast are covered in long tawny gold and black feathers. It stands on exactly two scaly yellow rooster legs with long spurs and spread toes. Two feathered wings rise from its shoulders. Behind the legs its body has no bird's tail: it narrows into one long thick scaly dark green serpent's tail that curls round behind it in a big loop and ends in a point.
colours: a red comb and red wattles, a yellow beak, tawny gold and black neck and breast feathers, dark bronze-brown wings, scaly yellow legs, a dark green scaly serpent tail with a pale yellow underside, an orange eye.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it faces left, standing on its two rooster legs with one foot lifted and the claws spread to strike, breast pushed out, both wings raised and half open above its back, neck stretched forward with the beak wide open in a screech, and the green serpent tail curled up behind it in a big loop.
must_show: a rooster's head with a red comb and wattles
two bird legs and feathered wings
a long green scaly serpent tail in place of tail feathers
fierce, beak open, one foot raised

what: a carbuncle, the jewel-beast of the South American forests: a small wild animal with a great red jewel growing out of its forehead. The jewel is the first thing anyone sees: one big oval ruby-red gemstone, cut with facets, as large as the animal's whole ear, standing up from the top of its forehead between and above the eyes like a third eye of red glass, with a bright orange-white glint at its centre like a live coal. The animal itself is a real one, lean and fierce, built like a marten: a long low supple body on four short legs with sharp claws, a narrow wedge-shaped head, small flat round ears, small dark slanted eyes, a snarling mouth of sharp white teeth and one long bushy tail.
colours: one bright ruby-red jewel on the forehead with an orange-white glint at its centre; sleek very dark brown fur, nearly black along the back, with a dull cream patch on the throat, a black nose, white teeth.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing; the jewel grows from its forehead.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it springs to the left on four legs with nothing beneath it, body stretched long and low, hind legs pushing off and front claws reaching, head thrust forward with the big red jewel standing up from its forehead at the left of the picture, lips drawn back snarling, its one bushy tail streaming out behind and curving up, well inside the picture.
must_show: a small lean dark-furred wild animal on four legs, seen from the side
one large red jewel in the forehead, readable in the small sprite
snarling, teeth bared, springing
a real animal painted seriously, not a pet
must_not_show: huge jewel bigger than its head
jewel balanced on top of the head

what: a web spinner: a real orb-weaver spider, an animal, drawn large, lean and long-legged, with the true body of a spider: a small flat head section with a cluster of small black eyes and two short fangs, a long smooth oval abdomen marked with bold yellow and black stripes running across it, and eight very long, thin, jointed legs banded in black and orange. Between its two front legs it grips one fat round bundle of white spider silk, wound tight like a ball of wool, as big as its own abdomen.
colours: a smooth abdomen with bold yellow and black stripes, a silver-grey head section, long legs banded black and dull orange, black eyes, one fat white bundle of silk.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It grips exactly one fat round white bundle of silk between its two front legs, held out ahead of its head. It holds nothing else.
pose: Seen from above and a little from the front, it faces down and to the left with nothing beneath it, six long legs spread wide and bent at the knees, its two front legs stretched forward holding the white silk bundle out ahead of it, the striped abdomen raised behind.
must_show: a true spider body with eight long thin legs
an abdomen with bold yellow and black stripes
one fat white bundle of silk held in the front legs, readable in the small sprite
lean and long-legged, unlike the hairy black giant spider

what: a darkmantle: a cave creature that passes for a stalactite and drops on its prey, shaped like a stone spike with an octopus's skirt. Its top is one hard, rough, ridged cone of slate-grey hide that tapers to a sharp point at the very top, exactly like a hanging spike of cave rock turned point upward. Halfway down the grey cone, side by side and facing the viewer, are its two eyes: two big narrow slanted slits of bright glowing yellow, each as long as a tentacle is thick, with no pupils, set directly in the grey hide. From the wide bottom rim of the cone eight thick tentacles spread outward and downward, and a web of dark leathery skin joins each tentacle to the next, so the whole lower half opens like an umbrella. The inside of the web is dark maroon-red with rows of pale suckers along each tentacle.
colours: rough slate-grey and charcoal hide on the cone, like wet cave rock, with no blue in it, two bright yellow glowing eye slits on the cone, dark grey tentacles, a dark maroon-red inner web, pale bone-coloured suckers and tentacle tips.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Caught in mid-air as it falls, with nothing above it and nothing beneath it: the pointed grey cone uppermost and tilted to the right, the webbed ring of tentacles flung wide open beneath it and tilted towards the lower left so the dark red inside of the web shows, tentacle tips curling inward to grasp.
must_show: a pointed grey cone like a stalactite, point upward
two narrow glowing yellow eye slits on the cone, readable in the small sprite
a ring of thick tentacles joined by a web of skin, spread open like an umbrella
dark red inside the web
falling in mid-air, nothing above or below
must_not_show: octopus with a round bulging head
mouth with teeth on the cone
bat wings with a bat's body
cloud of black smoke round it

what: a grick: one thick, rubbery, limbless worm of the deep caves, as thick as a man's thigh, the dull colour of wet rock, its hide ringed with heavy folds from end to end. Its front end is all weapon: one big hard hooked black beak, open and snapping, set directly in the end of the worm, and round the beak grow four thick muscular tentacles, each as long as the beak end is wide, each lined on its inner side with a row of big pale hooked barbs. It has no eyes: the hide round the beak is smooth.
colours: dull grey-brown rubbery hide the colour of wet stone, with a paler dirty cream underside and darker bands in the folds, a glossy black beak, grey-brown tentacles with pale bone-coloured barbs.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, its body lies in one thick loop at the lower right and its front half rears up and strikes to the left in an S-curve, the black beak gaping at the left of the picture, the four tentacles flung open round it: one curling straight up, one straight down, one reaching far forward to the left and one bent back.
must_show: a thick limbless grey-brown worm, reared up in an S-curve
one hooked black beak at the front end
four thick barbed tentacles spread round the beak
no eyes, no legs
must_not_show: round sucker mouth full of teeth

what: a peryton, the winged stag of drowned Atlantis: a gaunt, fierce stag with the plumage of a bird. Its head and neck are a real red deer stag's, with a long muzzle, a black nose, upright ears, a rough throat mane and two big branching ivory antlers with many sharp points, and its mouth is open showing a row of sharp teeth. Its four long thin legs are a deer's legs with black cloven hooves. Its whole body, from the shoulders to the rump, is covered in dark green bird feathers in place of hide, and from its shoulders grow two great bird's wings of dark green feathers with black tips. Its tail is a fan of long dark green feathers. Its eyes are small and glow dull red.
colours: a tawny brown deer's head, neck and legs, ivory antlers, dark bottle-green feathers on the body, wings and tail with black wing tips, black hooves, small dull red eyes.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it dives to the left through empty air with nothing beneath it, its body horizontal like a leaping deer, front legs reaching forward and hind legs stretched out behind, both feathered wings raised high above its back, head lowered with the antler points aimed forward to gore, mouth open.
must_show: a stag's head with big branching antlers
four deer legs with hooves, body horizontal, seen from the side
two large feathered bird wings and a feathered body, dark green
diving to gore, antlers lowered

what: a bonnacon of the medieval bestiaries: a heavy wild bull on four legs, a real animal, with a horse's long thick shaggy mane running from its poll down the whole of its neck to its shoulders. It has a bull's broad head with a wide wet muzzle and rolling white-rimmed eyes, a deep chest, a humped shoulder and cloven hooves. Its two horns are the strange thing about it: they are thick, ridged and pale, and each one curls down and round beside its cheek in one full tight circle, the way the horns of a wild mountain sheep curl, so that the horn tips point in at its own jaw and can gore nobody. No horn points up or forward. Its tail is lifted high, and from under the tail, joined to its rump, bursts one short thick blast of orange and yellow fire, no longer than its own head.
colours: dark chestnut-brown hide, the brown of a horse chestnut, with darker brown-black legs, a long shaggy black mane, thick pale ivory curled horns, a grey-black muzzle, black hooves, one short burst of orange and yellow fire at its rump.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it gallops to the left on four legs at full stretch with nothing beneath it, front legs flung forward and hind legs kicking out behind, head turned back a little with the eye rolling, mane flying, tail lifted straight up, and the short burst of fire shooting out to the right from its rump, joined to its body.
must_show: a bull's body on four legs, seen from the side, galloping
a horse's long black mane down the neck
thick horns curled down in a full circle beside the cheeks, readable in the small sprite
a short burst of fire at its rump, joined to the body
dark chestnut-brown hide
must_not_show: long trail of fire running off the picture

what: a griffin: the gold-guarding beast of the ancients, eagle before and lion behind, a real beast that walks on all four legs with its body horizontal. Its head is a great eagle's head with a heavy hooked yellow beak, a fierce frowning brow, a golden eye and two upright pointed feathered ears. Its head, neck and chest are covered in white feathers. Its two front legs are an eagle's legs: scaly yellow, each ending in a big bird's foot with black talons. From the shoulders back it is a lion: a tawny gold lion's body, two strong lion hind legs with paws, and a long lion's tail with a dark tuft. Two great eagle's wings of dark brown feathers grow from its shoulders.
colours: white feathers on the head, neck and chest, a yellow beak, scaly yellow front legs with black talons, tawny gold lion fur on the body and hind legs, dark brown wings with paler tawny bars, a dark brown tail tuft, golden eyes.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: all four of its feet are planted on the ground and its body is horizontal, like a stalking lion's. Its front talons are braced wide, its head is thrust forward and low with the hooked beak wide open screaming, both wings are raised straight up above its back, and its lion's tail lashes behind.
must_show: an eagle's head with a hooked beak and white feathers
front legs with bird talons, lion hind legs and tufted tail
four feet on the ground, body horizontal, seen from the side
two large dark feathered wings raised
tawny gold lion body

what: Arachne of Lydia, the weaver of Greek myth whom Athena changed into a spider: a woman above the waist and a great spider below. Her upper half is a proud, stern, pale woman with a long neck, dark angry eyes, two thin fangs showing at her lips, and black hair bound up high with a gold band. At her belt the woman ends and her body joins the front of one huge spider: a great round glossy black abdomen swelling out behind her, marked with one bold dull-gold hourglass shape, carried on eight long, thick, jointed, glossy black spider legs that arch up high and come down in sharp points all round her. She has a small head, a long neck and long slender arms.
colours: pale ash-white skin on the face and hands, black hair with a gold band, a dark wine-red long-sleeved tunic with a gold border and a gold belt, a glossy black spider body and legs with charcoal highlights and one dull gold hourglass mark.
wears: She wears a weaver's fine ancient Greek tunic of dark wine-red with a gold border, with a high neckline and long sleeves to the wrists, which covers her whole upper body from throat to waist and ends at a broad gold belt where the black spider body begins; and a gold band in her hair.
holds: Her hands are empty and she holds nothing; both hands are raised in front of her with the long fingers hooked like claws.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from the left, she rears her woman's body upright above the spider body and leans to the left, both clawed hands raised to seize, head tilted down glaring, mouth a little open showing the fangs; her eight black legs are spread wide round her, the two front legs lifted off the ground and reaching forward, the black abdomen raised behind.
must_show: a woman above the waist, fully clothed in a long-sleeved wine-red tunic
a huge black spider body with long jointed legs below the waist
pale stern face, black bound hair, gold band
empty clawed hands raised
ornate and imposing: a named monster of myth
must_not_show: long dress hiding the spider body
spider's head with fangs below her

what: a displacer beast: a great black panther with two tentacles growing from its shoulders, a heavy, powerful, long-bodied big cat, as big as a tiger, with a broad heavy head, a wide blunt muzzle, small round ears laid back, thick neck, massive shoulders and huge paws. It has long white fangs and two glowing pale green eyes, and a long thick tail. Its long body is carried on three pairs of legs: a front pair, a middle pair under its belly and a hind pair. From the top of its shoulders grow exactly two tentacles, one from each shoulder: each is a long whip of black muscle as thick as the cat's own front leg along its whole length, like an elephant's trunk, and each ends in one broad flat paddle-shaped pad of dull tan, as big as the cat's head, edged with big ivory hooks.
colours: sleek jet-black short fur all over with dark charcoal-grey highlights, glowing pale green eyes, white fangs, a dark red mouth, black tentacles ending in dull tan pads with ivory spikes.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it stalks to the left with its body low and horizontal and all its feet on the ground, shoulders hunched, head low and thrust forward with the jaws open snarling; its two thick black tentacles rise from its shoulders and arch forward over its head to the left, one high and one lower, their big tan hooked pads hanging in front of its face ready to strike; its tail lashes behind.
must_show: a heavy black panther on all fours, seen from the side: a big cat, not a house cat
two thick tentacles rising from the shoulders, each ending in a broad hooked pad, readable in the small sprite
glowing green eyes, white fangs, snarling
an extra pair of legs under the middle of the body (six legs)
must_not_show: snakes with heads on the shoulders

what: a nue, the nightmare beast of Japanese legend that fell from a black cloud over the palace: one beast on four legs made of four animals. Its head is the head of a savage old monkey: a bare wrinkled dark red face with a heavy brow, deep-set yellow eyes, a wide open mouth with long white fangs, framed all round by a ruff of grey-brown fur. Its body is stout, round-backed and shaggy, covered in thick dark grey-brown fur with black along the spine. Its four legs are a tiger's legs: thick, strong, orange with bold black stripes, ending in big clawed paws. It has no furry tail: where its tail should be, one thick scaly dark green snake grows out of its rump, curves up behind it like a raised tail and ends in a snake's head with open jaws. The snake is the tail.
colours: a dark red bare monkey face with a grey-brown fur ruff, yellow eyes, white fangs, a shaggy dark grey-brown body with a black spine stripe, four orange legs with black tiger stripes, a dark green scaly snake for a tail with a pale belly.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it prowls to the left on four legs with its body horizontal and low, one striped front paw reaching forward with the claws out, head turned a little to the viewer with the mouth wide open in a shriek, the snake tail hooked up behind the rump, hissing.
must_show: a monkey's red face with fangs on a four-legged beast, seen from the side
a shaggy dark grey-brown body
four orange and black tiger-striped legs
a snake for a tail, raised, ending in a snake's head
must_not_show: ringed bushy tail as well as the snake

what: Cath Palug, the monster cat of Anglesey from the Welsh Triads, which ate nine score warriors: a great cat as big as a horse, drawn as a real Ice Age sabre-toothed cat, a smilodon, on four legs. It is massive in front and lower behind: a huge deep chest, enormously thick forelegs with paws as wide as shields, a short thick neck, a sloping back, lean hindquarters and a short thick tail. Its head is heavy and broad with a wide blunt muzzle, small round ears laid flat, one of them torn, and a shaggy ruff of fur round its cheeks and throat. From its upper jaw two curved ivory sabre fangs, each as long as its whole head, hang down far past its chin, plain to see. Its eyes are two narrow slits of glowing pale green, and the long curved claws of its front paws shine the same pale green.
colours: shaggy dark iron-grey fur with bold black stripes across the back and flanks, a paler ash-grey throat and belly, a black-ringed tail, two long ivory-white sabre fangs, a dark red mouth, narrow glowing pale green eyes, pale green shining front claws.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it springs to the left on four legs with nothing beneath it, hind legs driving off and both massive front paws reaching forward with the long shining claws spread, head thrust forward with the jaws stretched wide open so the two long sabre fangs stand clear against the backdrop, ears flat, ruff bristling, short tail stiff behind.
must_show: a massive sabre-toothed great cat on four legs, seen from the side, springing
two very long curved white fangs, readable in the small sprite
dark grey fur with black stripes, shaggy cheek ruff
glowing green eyes and long shining claws
huge, scarred and fierce: nothing like a pet

what: a catoblepas, the beast of the Nile marshes that Pliny named 'the one that looks downward': a heavy, sluggish black beast on four legs with cloven hooves, a real hoofed animal built like a black wildebeest, with a high humped shoulder, a sloping back and a deep chest. It carries its head as a grazing animal does: its neck slopes steeply down from the hump and its big, long, heavy head hangs at the very bottom of the picture with the snout level with its own front hooves. The head is broad and ugly: a wide flat snout, two short curved ivory tusks at the mouth, small ragged ears, and a long shaggy matted mane that hangs from its brow over its face and all down its neck like a curtain. Through the mane its two eyes glow bright red. Its tail is as thick as its leg from root to tip and ends in one big spiked ball of pale grey bone.
colours: a dark charcoal-grey and black hide with dull mud-grey highlights, a long matted dark brown mane, pale ivory tusks, two bright red glowing eyes, black hooves, a thick dark grey tail with a pale grey spiked bone ball.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it trudges to the left on four hoofed legs with nothing beneath it, its hump the highest point of its body, its neck sloping steeply down and its head lowered to the level of its front hooves like a beast grazing, the head tilted to roll its red eyes upward at the viewer, and its thick tail curled up above its rump with the spiked bone ball raised to smash.
must_show: a heavy dark humped body on four hoofed legs, seen from the side
the head hanging down at the level of its hooves, like a grazing beast
a shaggy mane over the face and neck, red glowing eyes readable in the small sprite
a thick tail raised, ending in a spiked ball of bone
must_not_show: head raised level with its back

what: an owlbear: a savage beast with the body of a great bear and the head of a great owl, reared up on its hind legs the way a real bear stands to fight. Its head is a real great horned owl's head, very large, as wide as the bear's shoulders, set straight on the shoulders with no neck: a broad flat round face of pale grey-white feathers ringed with a black edge, two fierce orange eyes half hidden under a heavy scowling V-shaped feathered brow, two tall upright tufts of feathers on top, and in the middle of the face one big hooked black beak, wide open. It has no muzzle and no snout. A thick mantle of pale grey feathers barred with black covers its head, throat, shoulders and upper back like a cape, and the long barred feathers hang down over its upper arms. Below the feather mantle it has a real bear's body covered in thick shaggy dark brown bear fur: a huge barrel chest and belly, short thick bowed hind legs with flat bear feet, heavy forelegs with big paws and very long curved black claws.
colours: pale grey-white feathers barred with black on the head, throat, shoulders and upper back, a pale grey-white feathered face with a black rim, fierce orange eyes, a black beak, shaggy dark chocolate-brown bear fur on the chest, belly, forearms and hind legs, black claws.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast and holds nothing; both front paws are empty with the claws spread.
pose: Seen from the side and turned a little to the viewer, it stands reared up on its two hind legs facing left, its body upright and leaning forward, its right front paw raised high above its head with the claws spread ready to swipe down, its left front paw held out ahead, the owl's head thrust forward with the hooked beak wide open screeching.
must_show: a bear's heavy dark brown furred body, reared up
a large owl's head: flat pale feathered face, hooked black beak, feather tufts, readable in the small sprite
a mantle of pale grey barred feathers on the head and shoulders, dark fur below
long claws raised to swipe
furious, not friendly

what: Scylla of Greek myth, the sea nymph whom Circe's poison turned into the terror of the strait, drawn as on an ancient Greek vase: a woman above the waist, a pack of dogs at her waist and a sea-serpent below. Her upper half is a tall, gaunt, wild-eyed woman with pale sea-grey skin, long wet black hair streaming to one side and a mouth open in a cry. At her belt the woman ends. Out from under the belt, growing from her own hips, thrust three long thick necks covered in short black fur, fanned out like three spread fingers, one held high, one straight ahead in the middle, one held low, and each neck ends in the head of a savage black hound with pointed ears, yellow eyes and open jaws full of big white fangs. Below the dog necks her body is one single enormous scaly sea-serpent's tail, as thick as her waist, which stands straight up under her like a pillar for the length of her torso, then winds into two heavy coils and ends in a broad forked fish's tail fin.
colours: pale sea-grey skin on the face, arms and hands, long black hair, a dark sea-blue long-sleeved tunic with a dull bronze belt and border, three black-furred dog necks and heads with yellow eyes and white fangs, a sea-serpent tail of dark blue-green scales with a pale cream belly and a dull bronze-green tail fin.
wears: She wears a plain dark sea-blue ancient Greek tunic with a high neckline and long sleeves to the wrists, which covers her whole upper body from throat to waist and ends at a broad dull bronze belt, where the dog necks and the scales begin.
holds: Her hands are empty and she holds nothing; both arms are flung up and out with the fingers spread.
pose: She rears up tall on her coiled sea-serpent tail and lunges to the left, both arms flung up and wide, head thrown back crying out; the three dog heads strike forward to the left from her waist on their long necks, one high, one in the middle, one low, all three snarling with jaws open; the coils of her tail are heaped beneath her and the forked tail fin curls up behind at the right.
must_show: a woman above the waist, fully clothed in a long-sleeved dark blue tunic
three long-necked snarling black dog heads thrusting from her waist, fanned high, middle and low
one thick coiled scaly sea-serpent tail below, ending in a fish's tail fin
pale grey skin, wet black hair, arms flung wide
must_not_show: whole dogs with bodies and legs

what: the Calydonian Boar of Greek myth, the beast Artemis sent to lay waste a kingdom: a real wild boar of monstrous size and age, a real animal on four legs, with a massive wedge-shaped head, a long snout, small furious red eyes, a great hump of muscle over the shoulders and a body that narrows to lean hindquarters and a thin tufted tail. A tall crest of thick stiff black bristles, each as thick as a spear shaft, stands up along its neck, hump and spine like a row of spikes. Two enormous curved ivory tusks, each as long as its whole head, sweep up and out from its lower jaw, with two shorter tusks above them. Three broken wooden spear shafts and one feathered arrow stand stuck in the thick hide of its shoulder hump, the marks of the heroes who hunted it. Its hide is scarred all over.
colours: coarse black-brown bristled hide with dark grey scars, a tall black bristle crest, a dark grey snout, small red eyes, huge ivory tusks, dark cloven hooves, pale wooden spear shafts and one arrow with white feathers stuck in its shoulder.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is an animal on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it charges to the left on four legs at full tilt with nothing beneath it, front legs flung forward and hind legs driving, head lowered with the great tusks aimed ahead, mouth open with foam at the jaws, the bristle crest standing straight up, the broken spear shafts slanting back from its shoulder.
must_show: a wild boar on four legs, seen from the side, charging
enormous curved ivory tusks, as long as its head
a tall crest of thick black bristles along the back
broken spear shafts and an arrow stuck in its shoulder, readable in the small sprite
huge, scarred and furious: the most fearsome beast of its family

what: a hell bovine: a soldier of the hell cattle, a heavy, grim beast-warrior as tall as a man, standing upright on two legs. It has the head of a real cow, painted as a real animal: a long broad muzzle with wide nostrils, small fierce dark red eyes under a heavy brow, ears sticking out sideways, and two short plain pale horns curving up from its skull. Its whole body is covered in short cattle hide in big bold patches of black and white: the head, thick neck, deep chest, belly, thick arms and legs alike. Its legs are an upright cow's hind legs ending in two big black cloven hooves, and a thin tufted tail hangs behind. Its hands are thick blunt dark fists. It is a painted, weathered, fearsome beast with a small head for its heavy shoulders.
colours: short cattle hide in big black and white patches on every part, a grey-tan muzzle, dark red eyes, two plain pale ivory horns, black hooves, a rough dark brown leather belt and loin flap, a halberd with a rough pale wooden shaft and a dark grey iron head.
wears: It wears only a rough wide dark brown leather belt with a short ragged leather flap hanging in front. Its head, chest and arms are bare black and white hide.
holds: It grips exactly one rough halberd in both fists, both hands on its shaft: a thick pale wooden shaft taller than itself, and at its top a dark grey iron head with one broad axe blade on one side, a hooked spike on the other side and a spear point on top. It holds nothing else.
pose: It stands upright on its two hoofed legs, striding to the left with one hoof forward, body leaning forward, the halberd held slantwise across its body in both fists with the iron head high at the upper left, about to chop down, head lowered so the horns point forward, nostrils flared, mouth open bellowing.
must_show: an upright cow-headed beast-warrior on two hoofed legs
black and white patched cattle hide all over, chest and arms included
plain pale horns, no crown, no cape
one halberd (axe blade, hook and spear point on a long shaft) held in both hands
grim, not a joke: a plain soldier next to the Cow King
must_not_show: plain axe with no spear point

what: Set's jackal: a hunting beast of the Egyptian god of the red desert, a real jackal on four legs drawn as large and lean as a racing hound, all bone and sinew, with long thin legs, a deep narrow chest, a tucked belly, and a long, slender, down-curved muzzle. Its two ears are very tall and stand straight up, and each ear is cut off square and flat at the top like a post. Its long stiff tail is held straight up and ends in a fork of two points. Its coat is short and jet-black all over. Its two eyes are narrow slits that glow dark red. Round its neck lies a broad Egyptian collar of gold set with a row of big dark red stones, and a broad gold band circles each of its four legs above the paw.
colours: short jet-black fur all over with dark charcoal-grey highlights, narrow dark red glowing eyes, ivory fangs, a dark red tongue, a broad bright gold collar with dark red stones, four broad gold leg bands.
wears: It wears one broad gold Egyptian collar set with dark red stones, and one broad gold band on each of its four legs.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, it lunges to the left on four legs with nothing beneath it, hind legs driving and front legs stretched forward, body stretched long and low, head thrust out with the long jaws stretched wide open to bite, lips back from the fangs, the two tall square-topped ears laid forward, the forked tail held stiffly up behind.
must_show: a lean jet-black jackal on four legs, seen from the side, lunging
two very tall upright ears with square flat tops
a broad gold collar with red stones and gold bands on the legs, readable in the small sprite
red glowing eyes, open jaws
a stiff upright tail ending in a fork
ornate and menacing: a god's own hound
must_not_show: cloud of darkness round the body
